# Groowiq

Groowiq is a growth marketing agency based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, serving clients across India. We combine paid media, search, content, branding and conversion-led web design—scoped around the growth bottleneck.

## Core Capabilities
- **Performance Marketing:** Meta and Google campaigns with clear account ownership, creative testing, UTMs and decisions tied to qualified demand.
- **SEO & Search Visibility:** Technical SEO, useful content and entity clarity for visibility across Google and AI search experiences.
- **Social Media Marketing:** LinkedIn and Instagram strategy, creative and distribution from Ahmedabad—measured beyond follower counts.
- **Web Design & Development:** Fast, accessible, search-ready websites built around the path from first visit to qualified enquiry or purchase.
- **Branding & Content Strategy:** Positioning, messaging, identity and content systems that help ambitious brands become easier to recognize, understand and choose.
